reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getScheduledAmount and uses the existing getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: The rule is added once in getScheduledAmount, but schedule-template.ts keeps its own op ternary deciding when to call the helper.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts; the call-site edits only pass the op through.

scope.why: Display and search code in the schedule lists (SchedulesTable filter, mobile list item and page) is also switched to the worst-case amount, which goes beyond planning. The desktop amount cell is left unchanged, so the search string and the shown value now differ.

maintainability.why: There is one definition, but it is selected through an optional third positional op argument after a boolean, so every caller has to remember to pass it (one desktop caller does not); schedule-template's own dispatch also stays.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount (op-driven approx branch); caveat: schedule-template.ts still decides with its own 'isbetween || isapprox' ternary whether to call it
